segments.name: Community Banking
products: checking, savings, and time deposit accounts
segments.description: Provides traditional commercial and retail banking services, including deposits and lending, to individuals, businesses and government customers.
segments.evidence: In this segment, interest income on loans and securities, and banking service fees are the primary source of revenue.

segments.name: Wealth Management
products: corporate and personal trust fund management
pension, profit sharing and other employee benefit funds management
segments.description: Provides personal, corporate, pension and fiduciary trust and investment services to individual and corporate customers.
segments.evidence: The Bank also performs personal, corporate, pension and fiduciary services through its Wealth Management department.

revenueModel.text: The Bank earns interest on loans, investments and deposits, banking service fees, and wealth management fees from assets under management, largely transactional or accrued month-end.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's noninterest revenue streams are largely based on transactional activity, or standard month-end revenue accruals such as asset management fees based on month-end market values.

changes.text: Beginning in 2024, Wealth Management was added as a reportable segment in addition to Community Banking.
changes.evidence: Beginning in 2024, Management determined that its Wealth Management function qualified as a reportable segment, in addition to Community Banking, because of the amount of fee income it generates, its discrete financial information, and its management and review by its chief operating decision maker.
